abusePreventionNotice: To detect short-term bulk registration, the browser stores a random device identifier locally. The server stores only purpose-bound digests of that identifier and the IP address; it does not collect hardware fingerprints or retain the raw device identifier or IP address.
codeDescription: A code was sent to {destination}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
customerTypeTip: Choose an individual or enterprise customer
failedDescription: The onboarding proof may have expired or been replaced, or the signed-in username does not match. Staff and super administrator accounts cannot redeem it; use a separate customer account.
failedTitle: Customer onboarding could not be completed
humanDescription: Complete a short check before a verification message is sent.
intentPreservedDescription: Your contact is verified. If the account already exists, sign in with the same username to continue. The proof stays in this tab for a short time.
loginAgain: Sign in with the correct account
readyDescription: Sign in to the account you just registered. The system will verify the username and this browser before binding the customer account.
redeemingDescription: Checking the registered account, contact verification, and one-time onboarding proof.
registerSuccessDescription: The login account was created. Sign in once to finish the customer binding.
successDescription: The signed-in account is now a customer account and can enter the customer center.
